spawn_only_separation.scope_limit: Spawn-only describes the explicit frozen-mod operations; generic reflected nested/output values may introduce indirect dependencies. LoadAsset occurs only in the spawn fallback.

source_and_runtime_gaps.fact: Official inline TFunction storage has alignment 16; selected 48-byte array placeholder gives parameter structure alignment 8. Observed field offsets agree. Actual selected caller alignment and target macro overrides remain unmeasured; this is not proof of a misaligned native call.

Kismet FName conversion deep-copies a returned FString and frees its raw parameter frame without visible destruction of the frame-owned original. Generic string/text frames require contained-value cleanup evidence on success and error. This is source-visible uncertainty, not a measured leak.
evidence: REPORT.md: FText can fail while Menu created succeeds

source_and_runtime_gaps.fact: FText active size and ValueOpsProperty are runtime discoveries, not absent native profile offsets; conversion descriptors, value operations and visible labels remain unproved. Ignored SetText pcalls can hide failures.

Concrete discovered descriptors and generic conversion/dispatch behavior remain unproved for menu padding, colors, vectors, anchors, Font.Size and object/int/bool properties. Generic reflection is legitimate; per-method hardcoded game descriptors are not required. Existing profile presence does not prove widths or live correctness.

Lua start, six key registrations and events, selected game-thread executor draining, SCO construction, widget lifetime/GC, LoadMap arming/delivery and reset behavior have no mod execution evidence. These are operational/semantic facts rather than new numerical profile keys.
